# Tabs

<!-- MAP:START (generated by .kiro/scripts/build-docs.py from rp-map.json) -->
**`rp-tabs`** = `Tabs` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/Tabs` · Figma: Tabs · no class = `variant="fullWidth"`

| Class | Code |
|---|---|
| `rp-tabs-standard` | variant="standard" |
| `rp-tabs-scrollable` | variant="scrollable" |
| `rp-tab` | Tab (label) |
| `rp-tab-counter` | Tab counter |
| `rp-tab-panel` | TabsContent (the panel of a tab) |
| `rp-tab-selected` | Tab selected |
| `rp-tab-disabled` | Tab disabled |
| `rp-tab-size-small` | Tab size="small" |
| `rp-tab-size-large` | Tab size="large" |
<!-- MAP:END -->

`Tabs` default is `variant="fullWidth"` (tabs share the width). `rp-tabs-standard` fits each tab to its label.

```html
<div class="rp-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Establishment type">
  <button type="button" class="rp-tab rp-tab-selected" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tabHotels">Hotel</button>
  <button type="button" class="rp-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tabRestaurants">Restaurants <span class="rp-tab-counter">4</span></button>
</div>
<div class="rp-tab-panel" id="tabHotels" role="tabpanel">…</div>
<div class="rp-tab-panel" id="tabRestaurants" role="tabpanel" hidden>…</div>
```
- shared.js selects the tab, shows its panel (`aria-controls`) and handles arrow keys.
- Tabs that are separate pages are links: `<a class="rp-tab" href="results.html">` (the same tab bar on every page, the right tab selected).
- Inside a tile: add `rp-tile-tabs` and place the bar first in the tile.
